sourceReview.scope: Source inspection only: fixed Z parameters, actual-triangle mouth projection, three-target and 59-mesh/rig/material preservation guards.

improvementsOverRejectedV12: The profile's stepped protruding lips and pursed expression are substantially reduced.
The two conspicuous nose-base pits disappear.
Long mouth-corner grooves into the cheeks are reduced.
rejectionReasonsAgainstV11: The closed-mouth line is less legible than v11 in the three-quarter view.
Fine horizontal bright lip bands remain.
The nose and mouth still read as soft dough-like volumes; the candidate is not demonstrably more natural than v11.
scope: Rejected geometry candidate. Preserve the source, BLEND/FBX, manifest and all four original previews. Do not import into Unity. No additional variants or blind control-cage amplitude tuning in this study.
currentPlayableSelection: character-v11 head with the separately accepted balanced lighting; the geometry candidate is not used.
limits: Neutral CPU previews compare geometry under identical studio conditions, not normal-game rendering or performance.
Preserved channels and export completion do not constitute artistic acceptance.
Mouth clearance measures 114 vertices along world Y; it is not a proof of clearance for the entire ribbon, along surface normals, or every animated pose.
No new GLB or FBX roundtrip acceptance was requested after the visual rejection.
